description: Pointer + provenance for a raw fetched document.

bytes_size.description: Size of the stored raw payload in bytes.
bytes_size.title: Bytes Size

doc_id.description: Content-addressed document id, sha256 of the canonical URL.
doc_id.title: Doc Id

etag.description: HTTP ETag, used by the poller for conditional GET.
etag.title: Etag

fetched_at.description: UTC instant the fetcher received the response.
fetched_at.title: Fetched At

http_last_modified.description: Value of the HTTP Last-Modified response header if present.
http_last_modified.title: Http Last Modified

raw_html_s3_uri.description: Pointer to the gzipped raw bytes in MinIO.
raw_html_s3_uri.title: Raw Html S3 Uri

source_feed.description: SourceFeed CRD name that produced this fetch.
source_feed.title: Source Feed

source_format.description: Wire shape of the document; downstream extractors dispatch on this.
source_format.title: Source Format

spdx_license.description: OSI-list verified SPDX id (e.g. 'Apache-2.0'); None when no machine-readable license was attached to the source.
spdx_license.title: Spdx License

spdx_license_source.description: Where the SPDX id was read from.
spdx_license_source.title: Spdx License Source
